routing_test.interpretation: Disagreement is not an error metric because source labels are heuristic and several are demonstrably surface-based.

excluded_from_blind_proof_metrics.reason: reference exposed before prediction freeze and duplicated translation is corrupted

proof_forward_test.selection: five clean unexposed problems chosen to cover tractable representatives of discrete algebra, functional equations, inequalities, polynomials, and recurrences

results.reference_comparison: answer and residue-class counting mechanism agree
candidate found the shared-fiber structure but did not complete the equivalence-class argument
Jensen proof and equality case agree
candidate equivalently reduces to x^2-a*x+1=0; supplied reference makes an arithmetic error in the auxiliary discriminant

limitations: The five proof problems were deliberately selected for coverage and tractability, not randomly sampled.
No heldout Proof DAG, mutation, or Lean artifact was built in this test.
No claim is made for the two corrupted statements or the three reference-exposed records.
The frozen Skill must remain unchanged; findings may inform only a later version.
conclusion: v0.2 passes a small post-freeze proof-layer forward test with one honest blocked case and detects one defective reference solution. This is evidence of usefulness, not evidence of 20,000-problem scalability.
